Chart.js v4.4.1 (MIT License, https://www.chartjs.org/), served from this folder so the admin Metrics
page works offline, behind firewalls and with ad blockers, with no CDN request.
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js
To upgrade, replace chart.umd.min.js with the new build and check the Metrics page.
